content: Open strategic decision: SPIRAL name handling before Zenodo mirror / next public release. Three options: (a) accept-and-differentiate using HTCA as the distinct lineage marker (lowest cost — HTCA has zero external claims), (b) rename public-facing artifacts entirely, (c) cite-and-position relative to the AAAI SPIRAL paper. Decision is forced — academic SPIRAL references are entrenching and at least one collision has negative connotation drift ("Delusional Spirals" pejorative). Pending Anthony's call. Related open thread: 21-day quiet-streak instrumentation — should the streak-counter be made explicit in the tracker so each publishing event has a clean before/after measurement?
